state.title: State (2-letter)
state.description: Keep only incidents in this state, e.g. LA. Leave blank for every state.

dateFrom.title: From date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Keep incident dates on or after YYYY-MM-DD within the 2026 receipt-year workbook. Missing or malformed dates are excluded when a date filter is set.

dateTo.title: To date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: Keep incident dates on or before YYYY-MM-DD. This does not load another annual file.

materialKeyword.title: Material keyword
materialKeyword.description: Case-insensitive match against material names only, such as diesel. Reports include all of their listed materials.

maxItems.title: Max incidents
maxItems.description: Return up to this many matching reports, newest incident date first. SUMMARY records how many matches were omitted.

timeoutSeconds.title: Run timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Whole download/parse deadline. A timeout fails with UNKNOWN before results are written; it is not an empty successful search.

year.title: Report receipt year
year.description: This release supports the 2026 annual workbook. Incident dates can be earlier; other annual files are not yet accepted.
